**Desk assignment rules (evidence-based):**

Option C (regional office) — use sparingly. Accepted only in:
- Small claim, north region (REQ-2403)
- Large invoice, north region (REQ-2411)

Option C rejected for: all east-region requests (claim, shipment), south-region claim, north-region shipments. Avoid C for shipments and claims unless the pattern above clearly matches.

Option B (priority desk) — rejected for large refunds (both south and east region, REQ-2406, REQ-2409). Avoid B for refunds.

Option A (standard queue) — no data yet. Default fallback when B and C are both ruled out.

**Summary of rejections to remember:**
- C is not valid for: shipments (any region), claims (east/south), and was rejected on a north-region shipment.
- B is not valid for: large refunds.
- B was also referenced as invalid for REQ-2412 (large shipment, north) — so B is risky for shipments too.

**Unresolved:** Which option is correct for most ticket types? A has not been tried. Next step: when C and B are both contradicted, try A. Likely A is the default for standard queue items (shipments, refunds, etc.) and C is reserved for specific cases (small north-region claims, large north-region invoices).
